name: create_branch_quote_workbook
description: Creates a standardized Excel workbook for branch sales quotes in a wholesale distribution business. The workbook contains three sheets: Quote_Header (customer and job details), Quote_Lines (itemized pricing with calculated margins), and Summary (totals and overall margin). All formulas and sheet structures are fixed—the tool only inserts data into predefined cells. Use this tool when a sales rep needs to generate a formal quote document for a customer job.

quote_id.description: Unique identifier for this quote (e.g., 'Q-2026-00142'). Used for tracking and reference.

branch_code.description: The branch location code generating this quote. CLT=Charlotte, ATL=Atlanta, DAL=Dallas, HOU=Houston.

customer_name.description: Legal business name of the customer receiving this quote.

customer_contact.description: Name of the primary contact person at the customer company.

job_name.description: Short name or title for the job/project this quote covers (e.g., 'Maple Ridge Phase 2').

job_address.description: Physical address where materials will be delivered or the job is located.

sales_rep.description: Name of the sales representative responsible for this quote.

quote_date.description: Date the quote is issued (ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DD).

expiration_date.description: Date after which this quote is no longer valid (ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DD). Typically 30 days from quote_date.

payment_terms.description: Payment terms for this quote (e.g., 'Net 30', 'Net 15', 'COD', '2/10 Net 30').

freight_charge.description: Flat freight/delivery charge in dollars. Set to 0 for customer pickup or included delivery.

tax_amount.description: Sales tax amount in dollars. Set to 0 for tax-exempt customers or if tax is calculated separately.

line_items.description: Array of products/materials being quoted. Each item becomes a row in the Quote_Lines sheet.

sku.description: Product SKU or item number from the catalog (e.g., 'PVC-4-SCH40-10').

description.description: Human-readable product description (e.g., '4" PVC Schedule 40 Pipe, 10ft').

uom.description: Unit of measure for pricing and quantity (e.g., 'EA', 'FT', 'LF', 'CWT', 'TON', 'BDL').

quantity.description: Number of units being quoted. Must be greater than zero.

list_price.description: Standard list price per unit in dollars before any discounts.

cost.description: Branch cost per unit in dollars. Used for margin calculations (not shown to customer).

discount_percent.description: Discount as a decimal (0.15 = 15% off). Sell_Price = List_Price × (1 - Discount_Percent).

file_path.description: Server-side file path where the generated Excel workbook is stored.

download_url.description: URL to download the generated Excel file. Valid for a limited time (typically 24 hours).

subtotal_material.description: Sum of all Extended_Price values from line items.

freight_charge.description: Freight charge as provided in input.

tax_amount.description: Tax amount as provided in input.

overall_margin_percent.description: Total margin dollars divided by Subtotal_Material (as decimal).

line_count.description: Number of line items in the quote.
